1.word_for_word: पञ्चाशीतितमे राम-कृष्णौ संप्रार्थितौ सुतौ । — In the eighty-fifth year, Rāma and Kṛṣṇa had two sons, who were prayed for.; पित्रे ज्ञानम् अथो मात्रे मृतान् पुत्रान् अयच्छताम् ॥ — The father gave knowledge to the mother, and the dead sons gave it to the mother.; नन्दयित्वा कुरु-क्षेत्र यात्रायां सुहृदो बहून् । — He delighted many friends on his journey to the Kuru region.; तत्त्व-ज्ञानं ततः पित्रोर् आदिशन् मृत-सूनुभिः ॥१॥ — Then he taught his fathers the knowledge of the truth by his dead sons.
1.translation: In the eighty-fifth year, Rāma and Kṛṣṇa had two sons, who were prayed for. The father gave knowledge to the mother, and the dead sons gave it to the mother. He delighted many friends on his journey to the Kuru region. Then he taught his fathers the knowledge of the truth by his dead sons.

ननु प्राणादीनां विचित्र-शक्तीनां कारणत्वावगमात् कथं परमेश्वरस्यैव कारणत्वेन सर्वात्मकत्वम् उच्यत इत्य् आशङ्क्य प्राणादि-शक्तयोऽपि तस्यैवेत्य् आह---प्राणादीनाम् इति । — If, indeed, the various energies such as the life-force are understood to be the cause, how can it be said that God is the cause of all things?; प्राणः सूत्रं तद्-आदीनां विश्व-सृजां विश्व-कारणानां याः शक्तयस् ताः परस्य परम-कारणस्येश्वरस्यैव । — The life-force is the thread, and the powers that create the universe, beginning with it, belong to the Supreme Cause, the Supreme Lord.; कुतः ? — Where is it from?; पारतन्त्र्यात् । — From transcendence.; यथा वेध-शक्तिर् न बाणस्य, अपि तु पुरुषस्य तद्वद् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that just as the power of piercing is not the power of an arrow, but of a man.; ननु भगवतः प्राणादि-वर्गस्य च स्वातन्त्र्यम् एव किं न स्याद् अत आह---वैसादृश्याद् वयोर् इति । — If, indeed, the Supreme Personality of Godhead and the living entities are independent, why should there not be independence?; चेतन-शेतनत्वेन विस-दृशत्वाद् द्वयोः । — Because they are both conscious and conscious, they are dis-visible.; अचेतन-प्राणादि-वर्गस्य चेतन-पारतन्त्र्यम् एव युक्तम् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that the conscious transcendence of the unconscious, the life-force and other classes is justified.; यद् वा, प्राणादिषु द्वयोर् द्वयोर् एव तावद् विस-दृशत्वं विरुद्ध-क्रिया-कारित्वात् किं पुनर् बहूनाम् । — Or, in other words, in the life-force and other things, only two of them are so different, since they are the cause of opposite actions, what to speak of many.; तस्माद् एकेन सर्व-ज्ञेन सर्व-शक्तिनाधिष्ठितानाम् एव विशिष्ट-कार्यारम्भकत्वं युक्तं न स्वतन्त्राणाम् इति । — Therefore it is proper that only those who are possessed by the One omniscient and omnipotent should be the initiators of specific activities, not those who are independent.; तथा चोक्तम्, — And it is said,; > यदैते संहता भावा भूतेन्द्रिय-मनो-गुणाः । — > When these emotions, the senses, the mind and the modes of nature are combined.; >
> यदायतन-निर्माणे न शेकुर् ब्रह्म-वित्तम ॥ — >
> O best of the brāhmaṇas, they could not build the temple.; >
> तदा संहत्य चान्योन्यं भगवच्-छक्ति-चोदिताः । — >
> Then they gathered together and were encouraged by the power of the Lord.; >
> सद्-असत्त्वम् उपादाय चोभयं ससृजुर् ह्य् अदः ॥ — >
> They took both good and evil and created them.; इति । — It is.; तथा, नानात्वात् स्व-क्रियानीशाः प्रोचुः प्राञ्जलयो विभुम् [भा।पु। — Thus, because of their diversity, the masters of their actions spoke to the Lord with folded hands [Bh.p.; ३.५.३७] इत्य्-आदि । — 3.5.37] etc.; ननु प्राणादीनां क्रिया-कारित्वं शक्त्य्-अभावे कुतः स्याद् अत आह---चेष्टैव चेष्टताम् इति । — If, indeed, the life-force and others are the agents of action, how can they be in the absence of power?; चेष्टमानानाम् एषां चेष्टैव, न तु शक्तिः । — These things that are moving are moving, not power.; यथा वायोः शक्त्या तृणादीनां चलनम् । — Just as grass and other objects move by the force of the wind; यथा वा पुरुषस्य शक्त्या शराणां वेग इति ॥६॥ — Or as the speed of arrows by the power of a man.
6.translation:
If, indeed, the various energies such as the life-force are understood to be the cause, how can it be said that God is the cause of all things? The life-force is the thread, and the powers that create the universe, beginning with it, belong to the Supreme Cause, the Supreme Lord. Where is it from? From transcendence. This means that just as the power of piercing is not the power of an arrow, but of a man. If, indeed, the Supreme Personality of Godhead and the living entities are independent, why should there not be independence? Because they are both conscious and conscious, they are dis-visible. This means that the conscious transcendence of the unconscious, the life-force and other classes is justified. Or, in other words, in the life-force and other things, only two of them are so different, since they are the cause of opposite actions, what to speak of many. Therefore it is proper that only those who are possessed by the One omniscient and omnipotent should be the initiators of specific activities, not those who are independent. And it is said, > When these emotions, the senses, the mind and the modes of nature are combined. >
> O best of the brāhmaṇas, they could not build the temple. >
> Then they gathered together and were encouraged by the power of the Lord. >
> They took both good and evil and created them. It is. Thus, because of their diversity, the masters of their actions spoke to the Lord with folded hands [Bh.p. 3.5.37] etc. If, indeed, the life-force and others are the agents of action, how can they be in the absence of power? These things that are moving are moving, not power. Just as grass and other objects move by the force of the wind Or as the speed of arrows by the power of a man.

8.word_for_word: किं च हे देव, अपां तर्पणं तृप्ति-जनकत्वं प्राणनं जीवन-हेतुत्वं ता आपश् च तासां रसश् च त्वम् एव । — What is more, O God, You are the source of satisfaction, the life-giver, the life-giver, the waters, and the taste of them.; किं च वायोर् ओजः-सह-आदि तवैव शक्तिः ॥८॥ — What is more, the energy of the wind, with its origin, is Your own power.
8.translation: What is more, O God, You are the source of satisfaction, the life-giver, the life-giver, the waters, and the taste of them. What is more, the energy of the wind, with its origin, is Your own power.

9.word_for_word: दिशाम् उपाधिकृताकाश-प्रदेशानाम् अवकाशो दिशश् च त्वम् । — You are the space and the directions of the regions of the sky that are called directions.; खं सामान्याकाशस् तद् आश्रयः स्फोटश् च शब्द-तन्-मात्रं परावस्था वाग् इत्य् अर्थः । — The sky is the general sky, its shelter, the explosion, the sound-matter, the transcendental state, speech.; नादः पश्यन्ती । — Looking at the sound.; ओङ्कारी मध्यमा । — Omkari in the middle.; वर्णश् चाकृतीनां पदार्थानां पृथक् कृतिः पृथक् करणम् अभिढाणं यस्मात् तत् पदम् । — Varṇa is the term from which the objects of the forms are separated from each other.; वर्ण-पदाद्य्-आत्मिका वैखरी च त्वम् इत्य् अर्थः ॥९॥ — This means that you are the Self of Varna, Pada and others and Vaikhari.
9.translation: You are the space and the directions of the regions of the sky that are called directions. The sky is the general sky, its shelter, the explosion, the sound-matter, the transcendental state, speech. Looking at the sound. Omkari in the middle. Varṇa is the term from which the objects of the forms are separated from each other. This means that you are the Self of Varna, Pada and others and Vaikhari.

10.word_for_word: इन्द्रियाणाम् इन्द्रियं विषय-प्रकाशन-शक्तिर् देवाश् चेन्द्रियाधिष्ठातारस् तद् अनुग्रहस् तेषाम् अधिष्ठान-शक्तिश् च त्वम् । — You are the sense of the senses, the power to illuminate objects, and the gods are the masters of the senses.; अवबोधोऽध्यवसाय-शक्तिः । — Understanding is the power of determination.; अनुस्मृतिः प्रतिसन्धान-शक्तिः ॥१०॥ — Remembering is the power of rediscovery.; : व्यवसाय-शक्ति इति पाठः। — The text is business-power.; : जीवोपाधेश् चित्तस्यानुस्मृतिर् धारणा सती भगवन्-निष्ठानुकूला। — The remembrance of the mind in the concept of the living entity is true and conducive to devotion to the Lord.
10.translation: You are the sense of the senses, the power to illuminate objects, and the gods are the masters of the senses. Understanding is the power of determination. Remembering is the power of rediscovery. The text is business-power. The remembrance of the mind in the concept of the living entity is true and conducive to devotion to the Lord.

11.word_for_word: भूतानां कारणं भूतादिस् तामसोऽहङ्कारस् त्वम् असि । — You are the cause of all beings, the origin of all beings, and the ego of the darkness.; इन्द्रियाणां कारणं तैजसो राजसोऽहङ्कारस् त्वम् । — You are the cause of the senses, and you are the ego of the mode of passion.; विविधम् अधिदैवाध्यात्माधिभूत-भेदेन विकल्प्यन्त इति विकल्पा देवास् तेषां कारणं वैकारिकः सात्त्विकोऽहङ्कारश् च त्वम् । — The various supernatural, spiritual and supernatural distinctions are made by the distinction between the supernatural and the supernatural.; अनुशायिनां जीवानां संसार-कारणं प्रधानं त्वम् ॥११॥ — Thou art the chief cause of the world of living beings lying down.
11.translation: You are the cause of all beings, the origin of all beings, and the ego of the darkness. You are the cause of the senses, and you are the ego of the mode of passion. The various supernatural, spiritual and supernatural distinctions are made by the distinction between the supernatural and the supernatural. Thou art the chief cause of the world of living beings lying down.

12.word_for_word: अपि च नश्वरेषु नाश-शीलेष्व् इहैतेषु भावेषु यद् अनश्वरम् अवशिष्यमाणं रूपं तत् त्वम् असि । — Moreover, in these mortal and perishable beings of this world, You are the form that remains immortal.; द्रव्य-विकारेषु मृ-सु-वर्णादि-कार्येषु घट-कुण्डलादिषु अश्वरेषु च द्रव्य-मात्रं मृत्-सुवर्णादि-मात्रम् अनश्वरं यथा तद्वत् ॥१२॥ — In the transformations of matter, in the works of clay, gold, gold, etc., and in the pots, earrings, etc., and in the horses, the mere matter, such as clay, gold, etc., is immortal.
12.translation: Moreover, in these mortal and perishable beings of this world, You are the form that remains immortal. In the transformations of matter, in the works of clay, gold, gold, etc., and in the pots, earrings, etc., and in the horses, the mere matter, such as clay, gold, etc., is immortal.

13.word_for_word: ननु त्रि-गुणात्मक-कार्य-रूपोऽपि त्वम् इत्य् उक्तत्वात् कथम् अनश्वरत्वं तत्राह---सत्त्वम् इति । — If, indeed, it is said that you are also the form of the threefold action, how can you be immortal?; तद् वृत्तयस् तत् परिणामाश् च महद्-आदयः । — That instinct and its consequences are the beginning of the great.; अद्धा साक्षात् त्वयि परे ब्रह्मणि कल्पिताः ॥१३॥ — Half of them are directly conceived in You, the Supreme Brahman.
13.translation: If, indeed, it is said that you are also the form of the threefold action, how can you be immortal? That instinct and its consequences are the beginning of the great. Half of them are directly conceived in You, the Supreme Brahman.

14.word_for_word:
तस्मान् न सन्तीति । — Therefore, they are not.; नन्व् असतां कथं प्रतीतिरत आह---यर्हीति । — Now, how does one perceive the unreal?; यदा विकल्पितास् तदैव प्रतीति मात्रेण त्वयि सन्ति, त्वं चामीषु तदैव कारणतयानुगतः । — When they are chosen, they are in you by mere perception, and you are followed by them as a cause.; अन्यदा त्व-व्यावहारिको विकल्पकस् त्वम् एवावशिष्यस इत्य् अर्थः ॥१४॥ — Otherwise, it means that you will remain the practical alternative.; : यदा सुप्ति-प्रलयादौ न सन्ति कल्पकाभावात् तदा त्वम् अप्य् एषु
नासि सत्त्वेन नानुवर्तसे। — When there are no sleep and doomsday because of the absence of the Kalpaka, then you are also in them
You are not in essence and you do not follow.; : अन्यदा सृष्टि-स्थित्यादौ तु व्यावहारिकः
व्यावहारिक-सत्ता-साधकतयेति तोष। — Other times, however, it is practical in the beginning of creation and state
Satisfaction as a practical entity-seeker.
14.translation:
Therefore, they are not. Now, how does one perceive the unreal? When they are chosen, they are in you by mere perception, and you are followed by them as a cause. Otherwise, it means that you will remain the practical alternative. When there are no sleep and doomsday because of the absence of the Kalpaka, then you are also in them
You are not in essence and you do not follow. Other times, however, it is practical in the beginning of creation and state
Satisfaction as a practical entity-seeker.

15.word_for_word: एवं-रूपत्वाद् अज्ञान-निबन्धनश् च संसार इत्य् आह---गुण-प्रवाह इति । — Because of this form, the world is also bound by ignorance, he argues, because it is the flow of the modes.; सूक्ष्मां निष्प्रपञ्चां गतिम् अबुधा अविद्वांसः । — The ignorant are ignorant of the subtle and unpretentious movement of the universe.; अबुद्ध्वेति वा पाठः । — or the text, ignorant.; अतोऽबोधेन देहाभिमानेन कृतैः कर्मभिः संसरन्तीति ॥१५॥ — Therefore, by the actions performed by the ego of the body out of ignorance, they move about in this world.
15.translation: Because of this form, the world is also bound by ignorance, he argues, because it is the flow of the modes. The ignorant are ignorant of the subtle and unpretentious movement of the universe. or the text, ignorant. Therefore, by the actions performed by the ego of the body out of ignorance, they move about in this world.

16.word_for_word: एवं तयोस् तत्त्वं निरूप्य तद् अप्राप्त्या शोचति, यदृच्छयेति । — Thus, having determined the essence of the two, he laments for not having obtained it, saying that it is by chance.; नृतां मनुष्यताम् । — Let’s dance and become human.; सुकल्पां पटुतरेन्द्रियाम् ॥१६॥ — She was well-prepared and had a more skilled sense of humor.
16.translation: Thus, having determined the essence of the two, he laments for not having obtained it, saying that it is by chance. Let’s dance and become human. She was well-prepared and had a more skilled sense of humor.

17.word_for_word: अहो किम् इति प्रमत्तोऽसि, त्वया बहुभिः पाशैर् निबद्धत्वाद् इत्य् आह---असाव् अहम् इति । — Oh, what are you confused about, because you are bound by so many ropes?” He replied, “I am Asav.; देहे अस्य देहस्यान्वयादिषु पुत्रादिषु च ममैवैत इति ॥१७॥ — In the body of this body, in the descendants and in the sons and others, these are mine.; : देहे अहम् इति। — That I am in the body.
17.translation: Oh, what are you confused about, because you are bound by so many ropes?” He replied, “I am Asav. In the body of this body, in the descendants and in the sons and others, these are mine. That I am in the body.

18.word_for_word: अहो त्वत्-पुत्रयोर् आवयोः किम् इदम् आरोप्यते अत आह---युवाम् इति । — Oh, what is this being attributed to us, your sons?; भू-भार-क्षत्र-क्षपणार्थम् अवतीर्णौ तथा ह निश्चितम् आत्थ कथयसि ॥१८॥ — They descended to relieve the burden of the earth and the kṣatriyas You are certainly telling me so
18.translation: Oh, what is this being attributed to us, your sons? They descended to relieve the burden of the earth and the kṣatriyas You are certainly telling me so

19.word_for_word: तत् तस्माद् अरणं शरणम् आपन्नानां संसृति-भयम् अपहन्तीति तथा तत् । — That is why the forest is the refuge of those who have taken refuge in it, and that is what removes the fear of material existence.; ननु त्वम् अति-सुखी, वृथा किं निर्विद्यसेऽत आह---एतावतेति । — Surely you are very happy, why are you deprived of knowledge in vain?; इन्द्रिय-लालसेन इन्द्रियार्थ-तृष्णया । — By the lust of the senses and the thirst for the objects of the senses.; यद् येन इन्द्रिय-लालसेन मर्त्ये शरीरे आत्म-दृग् आत्म-बुद्धिर् अहं त्वयि च परे परमेश्वरेऽपत्य-बुद्धिर् अस्मि तेन अलम्, अलं पर्याप्तम् इति ॥१९॥ — That which, by the desire of the senses, I have seen myself in this mortal body, I have consciousness of myself, and I have consciousness of myself as a child in You, the Supreme Lord, is enough, enough is enough.
19.translation: That is why the forest is the refuge of those who have taken refuge in it, and that is what removes the fear of material existence. Surely you are very happy, why are you deprived of knowledge in vain? By the lust of the senses and the thirst for the objects of the senses. That which, by the desire of the senses, I have seen myself in this mortal body, I have consciousness of myself, and I have consciousness of myself as a child in You, the Supreme Lord, is enough, enough is enough.

20.word_for_word: ननु कुत एतद् अहं परमेश्वर इति तत्राह---सूती-गृहे इति । — Where, then, is this that I am God?; नौ आवयोः । — Nine of us.; अनुयुगं प्रतियुग्मम् । — Anuyugam pratiyugam.; यदा सुतपाः पृश्निर् इति युग्मम् । — When Sutapa and Prishni are paired.; यदा कश्यपोऽदितिश् चेति युग्मम् । — When Kaśyapa and Aditi are paired together.; अधुना वसुदेवो देवकीति युग्मम् । — Now Vasudeva and Devakī are paired together.; एवं हि प्रतियुग्मम् अज एवाहं सञ्जज्ञेऽवतीर्ण इति भवान् नूनं जगाद । — Thus, you must have said that I, the unborn, was born and descended from the counterpart.; नन्व् अन्योऽसौ चतुर्-भुजो देव इति तत्राह---नाना तनूर् इति । — Now, if this is another four-armed god, then he argues that there are various bodies.; गगन-वद् असङ्ग एव त्वम् । — You are as unattached as the sky.; भूम्नः सर्व-गतस्य विभूति-रूपां मायां को वेदेति ॥२०॥ — Who knows the illusory energy of the all-pervading Supreme Being in the form of glory?
20.translation: Where, then, is this that I am God? Nine of us. Anuyugam pratiyugam. When Sutapa and Prishni are paired. When Kaśyapa and Aditi are paired together. Now Vasudeva and Devakī are paired together. Thus, you must have said that I, the unborn, was born and descended from the counterpart. Now, if this is another four-armed god, then he argues that there are various bodies. You are as unattached as the sky. Who knows the illusory energy of the all-pervading Supreme Being in the form of glory?

22.word_for_word: उपमन्महे उपमन्यामहे । — We are like, we are like.; समुद्दिश्य विषयी-कृत्य । — intentionally objective-act.; तत्त्व-ग्रामस् तत्त्व-समूहः । — The element-gram is a group of elements.; उदाहृतः सम्यङ् निरूपितः ॥२२॥ — It is illustrated and properly described.
22.translation: We are like, we are like. intentionally objective-act. The element-gram is a group of elements. It is illustrated and properly described.

23.word_for_word: इमाम् एव दृष्टिं सर्वत्र विधत्स्वेत्य् आह---अहम् इति । — He argues that he should keep this same vision everywhere, saying, “I am.”; एवं विमृग्याः ब्रह्मत्वेनैवान्वेषणीयाः । — Thus they should be sought after as the Absolute Truth.; किं च, स-चराचरं जगद् अपि ॥२३॥ — What is more, the universe with its moving and non-moving beings.
23.translation: He argues that he should keep this same vision everywhere, saying, “I am.” Thus they should be sought after as the Absolute Truth. What is more, the universe with its moving and non-moving beings.

24-25.word_for_word: ननु नाना-विकारवतां कुतो ब्रह्मत्वम् ? — If so, where is the Brahmanhood of those who have various transformations?; इति चेत्, न, ब्रह्मण एवोपाधि-धर्मैर् बहुधा प्रतीतेर् इति स-दृष्टान्तम् आह द्वाभ्याम्---आत्मा हीति । — If this is so, no, he argues that the Brahman alone is perceived in many ways by the characteristics of the title, and he gives the same illustration in two ways: the Self.; यथा खादि-भूतानि तत्-कृतेषु घटादिष्व् आविस्-तिरो-भावादि यान्ति, एवम् असाव् आत्मा अप्य् आत्म-सृष्टैर् गुणैः कृत्वा तत्-कृतेषु देहेषु बहुधा ईयते, पुनश् च यथाशयं यथोपाध्य्-आविर्भाव-तिरोभावादि-रूपेण प्रतीयते, न वस्तुतः । — Just as food and other beings go into appearance and disappearance in the pots and other objects made by them, so the Asav soul, by the qualities created by the Self, is manifested in many ways in the bodies made by it, and again perceived in the form of appearance and disappearance.; कुतः ? — Where is it from?; एको बहुधा, स्वयं-ज्योतिर् दृश्यत्वेन, नित्योऽनित्यत्वेन, अनन्योऽन्यत्वेन, निर्गुणः सगुणत्वेनेत्य्-आदि बहुधात्वं प्रपञ्चनीयम् ॥२४-२५॥ — The one in many ways, the Self-Light as visible, the eternal as impermanent, the unique as other, the transcendental as transcendental, etc., should be explained in many ways.
24-25.translation: If so, where is the Brahmanhood of those who have various transformations? If this is so, no, he argues that the Brahman alone is perceived in many ways by the characteristics of the title, and he gives the same illustration in two ways: the Self. Just as food and other beings go into appearance and disappearance in the pots and other objects made by them, so the Asav soul, by the qualities created by the Self, is manifested in many ways in the bodies made by it, and again perceived in the form of appearance and disappearance. Where is it from? The one in many ways, the Self-Light as visible, the eternal as impermanent, the unique as other, the transcendental as transcendental, etc., should be explained in many ways.

27.word_for_word: सु-विस्मिता सती ॥२७॥ — The chaste woman was well-astonished.

30.word_for_word: भूमेर् भारायमाणानां राज्ञाम् अर्थे तेषां निधनार्थं मे मयि किलावतीर्णौ ॥३०॥ — They descended upon me in the fortress for the sake of destroying the kings who were burdensome to the earth
30.translation: They descended upon me in the fortress for the sake of destroying the kings who were burdensome to the earth

31.word_for_word: हे आद्य ! — O first !; यस्यांशः पुरुषः, तस्यांशो माया, तस्या अंशा गुणाः, तेषां भागेन परमाणु-मात्र-लेशेन विश्वोत्पत्त्य्-आदयो भवन्ति, तं त्वा त्वां गतिं शरणं गतास्मि ॥३१॥ — I take refuge in You, the ultimate destination, in whom the soul is a part, whose part is illusion, whose part is the modes of nature, and whose part is the creation of the universe and other things by the trace of an atom.
31.translation: O first ! I take refuge in You, the ultimate destination, in whom the soul is a part, whose part is illusion, whose part is the modes of nature, and whose part is the creation of the universe and other things by the trace of an atom.

32-33.word_for_word: आनिन्यथुर् आनीतवन्तौ । — They brought the Aninyathur.; पितृ-स्थानाद् यम-सदनात् ॥३२॥ — From the place of the fathers, from the house of Yama.
32-33.translation: They brought the Aninyathur. From the place of the fathers, from the house of Yama.

35.word_for_word: दैत्य-राड् बलिः । — The demon-king Bali.; कथं भूतौ । — How about the ghosts.; विश्वस्यात्म-भूतं दैवम् । — Destiny is the self of the universe.; सान्वयः स-परिवरः ॥३५॥ — Sanvayaḥ sa-parivaraḥ.
35.translation: The demon-king Bali. How about the ghosts. Destiny is the self of the universe. Sanvayaḥ sa-parivaraḥ.

36.word_for_word: स-वृन्दः स-परिजनः । — The same herd and the same family.; कथं भूतौ पादाव् अवनिज्य । — How can you lower your feet in the past?; यद् अम्बु ययोर् अवनेजन-उदकम् आ ब्रह्म ब्रह्माणम् अभिव्याप्य जगत् पुनत् पवित्रयद् वर्तते तौ ॥३६॥ — That water which pervades Brahman and purifies the universe, which is the water of their baths, exists in them.
36.translation: The same herd and the same family. How can you lower your feet in the past? That water which pervades Brahman and purifies the universe, which is the water of their baths, exists in them.

38.word_for_word: इन्द्रसेनो बलिः । — Indrasena is the sacrifice.; प्रेम-विभिन्नया प्रेमार्द्रया धिया । — With a love-different mind moist with love.; बिभ्रद् धारयन् ॥३८॥ — carrying and holding.
38.translation: Indrasena is the sacrifice. With a love-different mind moist with love. carrying and holding.

39.word_for_word:
अनन्ताय शेषाय । — For the rest of the infinite.; बृहते फणैक-देशे विश्रधारणाद् बृहत् तस्मै । — It is great for him to hold his trust in a large hooded country.; कृष्णाय सदानन्द-रूपाय च । — O Lord Kṛṣṇa, You are the form of eternal bliss.; वेधसे जगद्-विधात्रे । — O creator, the creator of the universe.; साङ्ख्य-योग-वितानायेत्य्-आदि-पद-त्रयम् ऐक्य-विवक्षया ॥३९॥ — The three terms beginning with the canopy of Sāṅkhya and Yoga are used to describe the unity.; : तोषण्यां तु साङ्ख-योगयोर् ज्ञानाष्टङ्ग-शास्त्रयोर् वितानं
[सोन्]{।मर्क्} । — But in the satisfying, the canopy of the eightfold scriptures of knowledge, Sankhya and Yoga
[Son]{.Merck}.; यद् एक-निष्ठस् तयोर् विस्तर इत्य् अर्थः। — That which is one-fidel means the detail of the two.
39.translation:
For the rest of the infinite. It is great for him to hold his trust in a large hooded country. O Lord Kṛṣṇa, You are the form of eternal bliss. O creator, the creator of the universe. The three terms beginning with the canopy of Sāṅkhya and Yoga are used to describe the unity. But in the satisfying, the canopy of the eightfold scriptures of knowledge, Sankhya and Yoga
[Son]{.Merck}. That which is one-fidel means the detail of the two.

40.word_for_word: योगेश्वराणाम् अपि दुर्दर्शौ युवाम् अस्माभिर् दृष्टाव् इत्य् एतन् नाति-चित्रम् इत्य् आह---दर्शनम् इति । — It is not very surprising that we have seen you, who are difficult to see even among the masters of yoga.; दुष्प्रापम् अपि युष्मत् कृपया केषाञ्चिद् अदुर्लभं सुलभम् अपि भवति तद् आह---रजस्-तमः-स्वभावानाम् इति । — Even what is difficult to attain becomes rare and easy for some by Your grace.; नो दर्शनं प्राप्तौ ॥४०॥ — We have not been able to see you.
40.translation: It is not very surprising that we have seen you, who are difficult to see even among the masters of yoga. Even what is difficult to attain becomes rare and easy for some by Your grace. We have not been able to see you.

41.word_for_word: अहो विद्-विषो वयं सात्त्विक-भक्तेभ्योऽपि स-भाग्य इत्य् आह---दैत्येत्य्-आदि-त्रिभिः ॥४१॥ — Oh, we are the enemies of the knower, and we are more fortunate than the Sattvic devotees!
41.translation: Oh, we are the enemies of the knower, and we are more fortunate than the Sattvic devotees!

43.word_for_word: उद्बद्ध-वैरेण या भक्तिस् तय । — The devotion to him that is bound by enmity.; केचनेति चैद्यादयः । — Some, such as Chaidya.; कामतो भक्त्या गोप्य्-आदयो यथा सन्निकृष्टास् त्वद्-आत्मतां प्राप्ताः । — Just as the gopīs and others, by lust and devotion, have attained to You, they have attained to Your Self.; तथा च सत्त्व-संरब्धाः सत्त्वाविष्टा अपि सूरादयो न सन्निकृष्टा इति ॥४३॥ — Similarly, even though they are enraged by Sattva and are possessed by Sattva, the Suras and others are not approached.
43.translation: The devotion to him that is bound by enmity. Some, such as Chaidya. Just as the gopīs and others, by lust and devotion, have attained to You, they have attained to Your Self. Similarly, even though they are enraged by Sattva and are possessed by Sattva, the Suras and others are not approached.

44.word_for_word: ननु सात्त्विकेभ्योऽपि राजसादयः सन्निकृष्टा इति चित्रं तद् आह---इदम् इत्थम् इति । — Indeed, it is strange that the Rajas and others are closer to the Sattvics.; इदम् इति स्वरूपतः इत्थम् इति विशेषतश् च ॥४४॥ — This is in nature and thus in particular.
44.translation: Indeed, it is strange that the Rajas and others are closer to the Sattvics. This is in nature and thus in particular.

45.word_for_word: तद् एवं यद्य् अपि वैर-भावेन त्वत्-प्राप्तिर् भवेत् तथापि मां सात्त्विकं कुर्व् इति प्रार्थयते, तद् इति । — That is why, even if I may attain You in the spirit of enmity, I pray that You will make me Sattvic.; तत् तथा नः प्रसीद । — That’s it and please us.; यथा निरपेक्षैर् आप्त-कामैर् अपि विमृग्यं युष्मत्-पादारविन्दं तद् एव धिषणम् आश्रयस् तस्माद् अन्यद् गृहं तद् एवान्ध-कूपस् तस्मान् निष्क्रम्य निर्गत्य विश्वस्य शरणं रक्षितारो वृक्षास् तेषाम् अङ्घ्रि-मूलेषु स्वत एव गलितैः फलादिभिर् उपलब्ध प्राप्ता वृत्तिर् जीविका — As the lotus feet of your feet are sought even by the absolutely attained, that is the refuge of meditation, that is the other house, that is the blind well, the trees that protect the refuge of the world; येन सोऽहं शान्तः सन्न् एक एव चरामि । — By which I am calm and walk alone.; उत अथव सर्वेषां सखायो महान्तस् तैः सह यथा चरामीति ॥४५॥ — Or else the great friends of all, as I move about with them.; : सर्व-सस्वत्वात्-ते मज्जु-गुप्सां न करिष्यन्तीति भावः। — Because they are all-possessing, they will not do the marrow-gupsa.
45.translation: That is why, even if I may attain You in the spirit of enmity, I pray that You will make me Sattvic. That’s it and please us. As the lotus feet of your feet are sought even by the absolutely attained, that is the refuge of meditation, that is the other house, that is the blind well, the trees that protect the refuge of the world By which I am calm and walk alone. Or else the great friends of all, as I move about with them. Because they are all-possessing, they will not do the marrow-gupsa.

46.word_for_word: कथम् अल्प-पुण्यानाम् एवं भावः सम्भवतीति चेत् तर्हि यथैतद् भवेत् तथास्मान् अनुशिक्षयेत्य् आह---शाधीति । — If we ask how it is possible for the less pious to feel this way, then he argues that he should teach us how to do this.; हे प्रभो, ईशितव्याः सर्वे जीवास् तेषाम् ईश यत् तवानुशासनम् आतिष्ठन्न् आश्रयंश् चोदनाया विधि-निषेध-लक्षणायाः सकाशाद् विमुच्यते । — O Lord, all living beings are to be worshipped, for those who obey Your discipline and take refuge in You are freed from the characteristics of law and prohibition.; न खलु त्वद्-भक्तो विधि-किङ्करः स्याद् इति भावः ॥४६॥ — This means that a devotee of You should not be a servant of the law.
46.translation: If we ask how it is possible for the less pious to feel this way, then he argues that he should teach us how to do this. O Lord, all living beings are to be worshipped, for those who obey Your discipline and take refuge in You are freed from the characteristics of law and prohibition. This means that a devotee of You should not be a servant of the law.

47.word_for_word: तद् उक्तं सर्वम् अनुमोद्य स्वागमन-कारणं स-प्रपञ्चं कथयति, आसन्न् इति पञ्चभिः । — Approving all that has been said, he explains the reason for his arrival and the universe, saying that they were there in five ways.; ऊर्णायां भार्यायाम् । — in the wife of Urna.; प्रथमेऽन्तरे स्वायम्भूव-मन्वन्तरे देवाः सुतां वाचं यभितुं यब्धुं मैथुनेन रमयितुम् उद्यतम् उद्युक्तं कं प्रजापतिं जहसुर् उपहसितवन्तः ॥४७॥ — In the first interval of the Svayambhuva Manu the devatas laughed at the creator of the universe who was engaged in sexual intercourse with his daughter in order to control her speech
47.translation: Approving all that has been said, he explains the reason for his arrival and the universe, saying that they were there in five ways. in the wife of Urna. In the first interval of the Svayambhuva Manu the devatas laughed at the creator of the universe who was engaged in sexual intercourse with his daughter in order to control her speech

48.word_for_word: तेनावद्य-कर्मणा पापेनासुरीं योनिम् अगन्न् अगमन् । — By that sinful act, they entered the demoniac womb.; अधुना तत् क्षणम् एव । — Now that’s the moment.; हिरण्यकशिपोर् जाता इत्य् अर्थः ॥४८॥ — This means that she was born of Hiranyakasipu.
48.translation: By that sinful act, they entered the demoniac womb. Now that’s the moment. This means that she was born of Hiranyakasipu.

49.word_for_word: ते च योग-मायया ततो नीताः सन्तो देवक्या उदरे जाताः । — They were then carried away by the illusion of yoga and were born in the womb of Devakī.; हे राजन् बले, ते च कंसेन विहिंसिताः । — O King Bala, they too were destroyed by Kaṁsa.; सा च तान् आत्म-जान् मत्वा शोचति । — She considers them to be her own children and laments for them.; ते चेमे तवान्तिकेऽध्यासते ॥४९॥ — They and these are dwelling near you.
49.translation: They were then carried away by the illusion of yoga and were born in the womb of Devakī. O King Bala, they too were destroyed by Kaṁsa. She considers them to be her own children and laments for them. They and these are dwelling near you.

50.word_for_word: लोकं देव-लोकम् ॥५०॥ — The world is the world of the gods.
50.translation: The world is the world of the gods.

51.word_for_word: स्मरोद्-गीथः स्मर-सहित उद्गीथः । — Smarod-githa is an udgitha with smara.; सद्-गुतिं मोक्षम् । — Sad-guti is liberation.; स्मरस्यैव पूर्वं कीर्तिमान् इति नाम । — Smara was formerly known as Kirtiman.; अतः कीर्तिमन्तं प्रथम-जं कंसायानकदुन्दुभिः । — Therefore, the famous first-born Kaṁsa-yanaka-dundubhi.; अर्पयाम् आस [भा।पु। — offering was [Bh.p.; १०.१०.५७] इत्य् उक्तम् ॥५१॥ — 10.10.57] It is said.
51.translation: Smarod-githa is an udgitha with smara. Sad-guti is liberation. Smara was formerly known as Kirtiman. Therefore, the famous first-born Kaṁsa-yanaka-dundubhi. offering was [Bh.p. 10.10.57] It is said.

52.word_for_word: अयच्छताम् अर्पयाम् आसतुः ॥५२॥ — They gave and offered.

55.word_for_word:
अमृतत्वे हेतुः, गदा-भृतः पीत-शेषम् इति । — The reason for being immortal is that the club-bearer is a yellow residue.; नारायणाङ्ग-संस्पर्शेन प्रतिलब्धं देवा वयम् इत्य् आत्म-दर्शनं यैस् ते ॥५५॥ — Those who have attained self-realization by the touch of the limbs of Lord Nārāyaṇa saying, "We are the demigods.; : पित्रोः सम्पश्यतोः सद्यो बभूव प्राकृतः शिशुः इत्य् उक्तेर्
नन्द-गृह-गमन-समये देवकी स्तनम् अपाययद् इति तत्रानुक्तम्
अपीह पीत-शेषम् इत्य् उक्तेर् अवगन्तत्र्यम् इति चक्र बाल। — It is said that the child immediately became a normal child in the presence of his father
It is not said that Devakī nursed her breast when she went to Nanda's house
Even here, the yellow-residue is understood to be the chakra child.
55.translation:
The reason for being immortal is that the club-bearer is a yellow residue. Those who have attained self-realization by the touch of the limbs of Lord Nārāyaṇa saying, "We are the demigods. It is said that the child immediately became a normal child in the presence of his father
It is not said that Devakī nursed her breast when she went to Nanda's house
Even here, the yellow-residue is understood to be the chakra child.

56.word_for_word: धाम देव-लोकम् ॥५६॥ — The abode is the world of the gods.
56.translation: The abode is the world of the gods.

57.word_for_word: मृतानाम् आगमनं निर्गमनं च श्री-कृष्णस्य मायां मेने । — He thought that the coming and going of the dead was the illusion of Lord Kṛṣṇa.; तेनैवापत्यादि-रूपेण रचिताम् ॥५७॥ — He created her in the form of a child and others.
57.translation: He thought that the coming and going of the dead was the illusion of Lord Kṛṣṇa. He created her in the form of a child and others.

59.word_for_word: अमृतं कीर्तिर् यस्य तस्य । — He whose fame is immortal.; व्यास-पुत्रेर् इति बहु-वचनं पूजार्थम् । — The plural form of the son of Vyasa is used for worship.; जगताम् अघं मिनत्तीति तथा तत् । — That’s how it mines the sin of the world.; अलं निःशेषं यथा भवति तथा न कृच्छ्रादि-वद् इति । — It’s not like it’s a troublesome thing, it’s like it’s not enough.; तद् एवं मोक्ष-हेतुत्वं पाप-क्षय-हेतुत्वं चोक्तम् । — That is thus said to be the cause of liberation and the cause of the destruction of sin.; तद् भक्तानां तु सत्-कर्ण-पूरं परम-सुखावहं कर्णाभरणम् इति स्वयं सुख-रूपताम् आह । — For the devotees of that Supreme Personality of Godhead, the Supreme Personality of Godhead is the earring of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; किं च भगवति कृतम् आवेशितं चित्तं येन स तथा भूत्वा तस्य क्षेम-धाम कालादि-भय-रहितं लोकं यातीति ॥५९॥ — What is more, one whose mind is fixed on the Supreme Personality of Godhead becomes such that he attains to the abode of peace, the world free from fear of time and other things.; : अमृतं परानन्द-रूपा। — Nectar is the form of bliss.
59.translation: He whose fame is immortal. The plural form of the son of Vyasa is used for worship. That’s how it mines the sin of the world. It’s not like it’s a troublesome thing, it’s like it’s not enough. That is thus said to be the cause of liberation and the cause of the destruction of sin. For the devotees of that Supreme Personality of Godhead, the Supreme Personality of Godhead is the earring of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. What is more, one whose mind is fixed on the Supreme Personality of Godhead becomes such that he attains to the abode of peace, the world free from fear of time and other things. Nectar is the form of bliss.
